summary: UI component constructor (component ID 242). Initializes the base subobject, installs the vtable, binds a data-source pointer, sets single-state configuration, inserts text and "On" string handles into a linked list, then dispatches post-init via the action ID virtual call.

operations.description: Invoke ShortComputation_6d60(this, 1) to initialize the base subobject with flag 1 before any derived fields are set.
Install the class vtable by writing the address of the off_5A12C0 vtable table into the object's vtable pointer at offset 0x0.
Bind the data source by storing the address of dword_7CE7CC into the data-source field at offset 0x31C.
Set value count at offset 0x324 to 1 (single-state component).
Set current state value at offset 0x328 to 0 (initial/off state).
Set minimum state value / enabled flag at offset 0x32C to 1.
Set maximum state value / visibility flag at offset 0x330 to 1.
Set unique component ID at offset 0x334 to 242.
Insert the off_5BE704 text handle into the component's linked list with node allocation and owner index -1.
Insert the aOn string handle into the component's linked list with node allocation and owner index -1.
